entities.name: Slave Punishment Systems
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Enslaved people faced whipping, branding, amputation, iron collars, salt in wounds, and forced family separation as systematic punishment. The Slave Codes legalized unlimited violence against enslaved people. Louisiana's Code Noir (1724) specified punishments by offense. The brutality was not incidental — it was the system.
